frontiers.scope: Canonical place names, coordinates, administrative geography, timezone identifiers, UTC offsets, and ZIP/GEOID crosswalks for public-reference use.
explicit_exclusions: tax domicile or legal residency determinations
frontiers.legal_posture_required: Prefer public-domain or attribution-only sources; isolate ODbL-derived outputs from unrestricted packs.

frontiers.scope: Official forecast, observations, and active alerting for local conditions and short-horizon planning.
forbidden_claims: shelter-in-place or evacuation advice beyond official wording
frontiers.legal_posture_required: Must preserve official alert wording/context; do not rebrand as proprietary warning authority.

frontiers.scope: Current and historical public air-quality indicators and exposure categories.
explicit_exclusions: regulatory enforcement determinations from preliminary data
frontiers.legal_posture_required: Separate preliminary AirNow claims from AQS regulatory history.

frontiers.scope: Earthquakes, flood maps, disaster declarations, and hazard-related public reference materials.
frontiers.legal_posture_required: Use official map or declaration references when consequences may be legal or financial.

frontiers.scope: Official transit schedules/realtime patterns, feed discovery, and vehicle reference/decoding.
forbidden_claims: vehicle safety certification from VIN alone
frontiers.legal_posture_required: Respect operator-specific transit feed licenses; treat standards docs separately from agency-owned data.

frontiers.scope: Public provider identity, taxonomy, location, drug recalls, and drug shortages.
explicit_exclusions: insurance network status unless explicitly sourced
frontiers.legal_posture_required: No medical advice; preserve source disclaimers on recall/shortage decision use.

frontiers.scope: Public recall and safety-warning facts for consumer products and motor vehicles, plus VIN/manufacturer reference.
forbidden_claims: product is safe because not found
repair completed or remedy available without source
frontiers.legal_posture_required: Keep remedy/status caveats and do not overstate completeness.

frontiers.scope: Federal statutes, bills, regulations, notices, and tax/publication reference.
explicit_exclusions: personalized eligibility for deductions or credits
forbidden_claims: this is the official legal edition when not
frontiers.legal_posture_required: Backstop legal-final claims with GovInfo or official PDFs; distinguish current unofficial presentations from official editions.

frontiers.scope: School outcomes/costs, occupation descriptions, skills, and labor/economic series.
frontiers.legal_posture_required: Preserve attribution and redistribution terms, especially for O*NET Web Services.

frontiers.scope: Fair Market Rents, income limits, ZIP-geography crosswalks, and official housing-counselor lookup.
frontiers.legal_posture_required: Use HUD disclaimer/non-endorsement notice when republishing API-driven outputs.

frontiers.scope: FDIC-insured institution identity, branch location, and institutional history reference.
explicit_exclusions: account coverage calculation without user balances
forbidden_claims: deposits are fully covered for the user
frontiers.legal_posture_required: Do not imply FDIC endorsement of the app or of linked institutions.

frontiers.scope: Public-domain nutrient and food composition reference for foods and branded products.
explicit_exclusions: restaurant-specific menu truth absent source linkage
frontiers.legal_posture_required: Preserve source attribution even though FoodData Central is CC0/public domain.
